title: 屋外公衆電話ポスト
description: 雨よけ、受話器、連続したコイルコード、操作キーと点検扉を持つ汎用屋外電話。通話や決済機能のない静的モデル。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: Unbranded weatherproof telephone on a service pedestal, with open rain hood, cradled handset, continuous coiled cord, tactile keypad and rear service door. Static visual prop without calling or payment functionality. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
